tests.name: test_examples
tests.description: The index of the smallest loss, for a few lists.
tests.message: best_step([2.0, 1.5, 1.7]) is 1.5, but the smallest loss, 1.5, is at index 1.

tests.name: test_first_slot
tests.description: The smallest loss can be in the first slot, and a list can hold a single loss.
tests.message: best_step([0.5, 0.9, 0.7]) is 0.5, but the smallest loss is in the first slot, index 0.

tests.name: test_ties
tests.description: When the smallest loss appears twice, the first of its indexes.

tests.name: test_unchanged
tests.description: best_step leaves the list it is given as it was.

tests.name: test_fresh
tests.description: Each call without a history starts a new list of its own.

tests.name: test_given
tests.description: A history passed in is the list that grows, and the one returned.
tests.message: After log(1.5, h) with h = [2.0], h is [2.0], not [2.0, 1.5]: log should append to the list it is given.

tests.name: test_given_empty
tests.description: An empty list passed in is still the caller's list, and it grows too.
tests.message: After log(1.0, h) with h = [], h is [], not [1.0]: an empty list passed in is still the caller's list, and log should append to it.

tests.name: test_examples
tests.description: Repeats are removed, and first appearances keep their order.

tests.name: test_order
tests.description: The order is that of first appearance, not sorted and not a set's order.

tests.name: test_fast
tests.description: On 300 documents, 100 of them different, fewer than 3,000 steps of work.
tests.message: unique did 15,150 steps of work on 300 documents, 100 of them different, counting each comparison and each time a set or dict worked out where a document goes. The puzzle's version makes 15,050 comparisons, and a version that looks each document up once does about 600 steps.

tests.name: test_unchanged
tests.description: unique leaves the list it is given as it was, and returns a new list.

tests.name: test_ids
tests.description: Each new token gets the next id, from 0.

tests.name: test_repeats
tests.description: A repeated token keeps the id it got when it first appeared.

tests.name: test_many
tests.description: Ten different tokens, in no particular order, numbered in the order they first appear.

tests.name: test_empty
tests.description: No tokens give an empty dict.

tests.name: test_fresh
tests.description: Each call numbers only its own tokens, in a new dict.

tests.name: test_unchanged
tests.description: vocabulary leaves the list of tokens as it was.
